{{Removed|date = 23rd of May 2023}} {{AttributeInfobox |image1 = Energy.png |type = Immunity |variants = Regular
{{Boss}}[[Boss]] |immunities = Regular: *{{Stun}}Stun {{Boss}}[[Boss]]: *{{Stun}}Stun *{{Stun|Partial Stun Slowdown}}Partial Stun Slowdown |tag = {{AttrTag|Second|Energy.png|No Energy}} }} ==Description== '''Energy Immunity''' (referred to as "''No Energy''" on its tag) was an immunity that prevented the enemy from being stunned. It has been replaced by [[Stun Immunity]]. ==Mechanics== '''Energy Immunity''' made it so that any enemy with it could not be stunned by stunning towers, which included the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]]. They will be instead slowed down by 25% for the stun duration. All [[Boss]] enemies have this immunity, as part of being a [[Boss]] enemy. The only difference between the two is that the slowdown effect is weaker on [[Boss]] enemies. ==Enemy List== The following enemies had the '''Energy Immunity''' before being replaced by the [[Stun
